functions.name: search_inventory
functions.title: Search Aircraft Inventory
functions.description: List all aircraft currently listed for sale on ClearBlue Aero's public inventory, including year, make, model, price, total time, engine time, avionics, location, and photos. Use this when someone asks what aircraft ClearBlue Aero has for sale or about a specific make/model in their inventory.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of listings to return, 1-200. Defaults to 200.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Number of listings to skip, for pagination. Defaults to 0.

functions.name: get_listing_details
functions.title: Get Aircraft Listing Details
functions.description: Get the full public details, specifications, photos, and description for one aircraft listing by its ID. Use this after search_inventory when someone wants specifics on a particular aircraft.

id.title: Listing ID
id.description: The aircraft listing ID returned by search_inventory.
